data.name: Charitra
data.gender_notes: Charitra is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'charitra' meaning a story or history. This name signifies the richness of one's past and the significance of sharing it with others. It is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who represents wealth, fortune, and prosperity. The name Charitra carries the meaning “Story, history” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Charitra usually hope their child will grow to embody story, history and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the essence of storytelling, wisdom, and the divine. It is a reminder of the importance of preserving and sharing the knowledge and experiences of the past.
data.etymology: Charitra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Story, history.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charitra total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
